svg.title: Quicksort
svg.desc: Quicksort. Partition around a pivot, smaller values left and larger right, then sort each side: fast in place, O(n²) when pivots are bad. Step 1, Partition around a pivot: Pivot 5: j scans; values ≤ 5 swap into the left zone at i, then 5 swaps into its final place. Step 2, Recurse on each side: Recurse on each side with the same move; each pivot lands for good: 15 comparisons, 8 swaps. Step 3, Bad pivots: O(n²): Sorted input: the last value is always the largest, so 7 levels and 28 comparisons: O(n²). Step 4, Fast in practice: In place, cache-friendly and O(n log n) on average, but not stable: library sorts build on it.

g.text: Pivot 5: j scans; values ≤ 5 swap into the left zone at i, then 5 swaps into its final place.

In place, cache-friendly and O(n log n) on average, but not stable: library sorts build on it.
sorted in place: swaps inside one array, no copy
swap a[i], a[hi] # pivot is final
